subject: QMon activation & integration bridge for ClearGuide onboarding
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Morgan <olivia@clearguide.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QMon activation & integration bridge for ClearGuide onboarding

Hi Olivia —

Great to meet you yesterday. Following up with the proposed QMon (Quality Monitoring) activation plan so we can align the CS/implementation handoff and lock in the first-week deliverables. High level: ingest prompt sets, wire the eval harness to your CI, enable regression alerts, and run a canary with rollback gates.

What we need from you to start:
- A sampling of 200–500 representative prompts (seed + variants) so we can build the initial prompt matrix. CSV format is fine — I attached a template.
- S3/GCS read access or a shared Drive link for any labeled outputs you want included.
- Contact for your engineering lead (we'll loop them into the harness integration).

Proposed technical milestones (week 0–2):
1) Prompt ingestion & labels mapping (Camila/Marissa owner)
2) Eval harness integration (Dylan owner) — Docker hook + example test cases in your repo
3) Canary matrix & rollback policy definition (Marissa + Dylan)
4) Alerting thresholds & dashboards (CS + Ops)

Key design notes:
- Canary/rollback: plan is to run a narrow percentage of traffic (5–10%) against the new model variant for 48 hours with automatic rollback triggers on:
  * >5% increase in critical-failure rate (as defined in the prompt matrix)
  * >15% latency P95 regression vs baseline
  * Any flagged safety/regression on high-severity prompt groups
- Regression alerts will be routed to your on-call Slack and our QMon channel; we'll create an eval-hook that runs nightly against a baseline promptset.

Attached: qmon-integration-checklist.pdf, initial-prompt-matrix.csv (template).

Can you confirm:
- Who should we expect to own the repo changes on your side?
- Availability for a 30min kickoff on Friday 8/25 (10–11am PT or 2–3pm PT)?

Thanks — once we have the prompt seeds + your engineer contact we'll schedule the technical walk-through.

Best,

Camila Reyes
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0132

Attachments: qmon-integration-checklist.pdf (6 pages), initial-prompt-matrix.csv (template)

Date: 2026-08-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QMon activation & integration bridge for ClearGuide onboarding

Thanks Camila — this looks good and actionable. Quick answers:
- We'll provide the prompt seed CSV; Rahul will own the repo changes. He's copied.
- We have some PHI constraints in our datasets; anything stored for eval will need to live in our secure S3 and be access-controlled.
- Friday 8/25 10–11am PT works for the kickoff.

Two clarifying questions from Rahul:
1) What languages does the eval harness support out of the box? We primarily run Python + a small Node microservice.
2) For the canary traffic split, can you run staged ramp (1% -> 5% -> 10%) and hold each stage for 8 hours? That's our preference.

Appreciate the checklist — we'll upload the prompt seed later today.

— Olivia
Olivia Morgan
Head of ML, ClearGuide Health
olivia@clearguide.com

Subject: Fwd: QMon activation & integration bridge for ClearGuide onboarding

Marissa / Dylan — forwarding ClearGuide thread. Highlights and asks below (internal):

- Customer: ClearGuide Health (deal CG-2026-158). Contact: Olivia (Head of ML), Rahul (eng lead).
- They have PHI constraints; all eval/storage must remain in their secured S3. We'll need a short compliance appendix in the runbook describing data handling and access patterns.
- Rahul asked about harness languages — we should confirm Python + Node support. Dylan, can you prepare a minimal Dockerized harness example (python test + node shim) and a checklist for the repo changes?
- Canary plan: customer prefers staged ramp 1% -> 5% -> 10% with 8-hour holds. We should define the rollback triggers concretely in the canary-matrix. Marissa, please own the canary matrix and the alert thresholds.

Immediate asks:
1) Draft a 1-pager runbook snippet for PHI-safe eval ingestion (for their security) — include KMS usage, minimal retention, and audit log hooks.
2) Draft canary-matrix CSV and initial thresholds.
3) Prepare the harness example repo link and a short walkthrough for Friday.

I attached the customer's prompt-template and our checklist in the outbound — you'll see details there. Let's align on a draft by EOD tomorrow so we can share before the Friday session.

Thanks,
Camila

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Morgan <olivia@clearguide.com>, Rahul Mehta <rahul@clearguide.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QMon activation & integration bridge for ClearGuide onboarding

Thanks Camila / Olivia. Looping in an initial implementation plan and owners below. I'm marking the items we will deliver prior to the kickoff and those for the first two sprints.

Pre-kickoff (by Friday 8/25 morning) — deliverables:
- Canary matrix draft (attached: canary-matrix.csv) — includes staged ramp: 1%/5%/10% with 8-hour holds and explicit rollback conditions (latency P95, critical-failure rate on safety set).
- PHI-safe eval runbook snippet (attached: qmon-runbook-draft.md) — covers KMS key flow, no-persist policy for sample prompts, and audit logging integration with your CloudTrail equivalent.
- Harness example repo link and short walkthrough doc (we will share the repo link in the Friday kickoff).

Sprint 1 (week 1–2) — tasks and owners:
- Prompt ingestion & label mapping: Marissa (CS) + ClearGuide data owner — map seed -> severity buckets.
- Eval harness integration + CI: Dylan (SE) — provide Dockerized test (Python + node shim) and a PR template for their repo.
- Alerting & dashboard: Marissa + Ops — create sample Slack alerts and a Grafana dashboard template.

Rollback/threshold specifics (summary):
- Rollback if any of the following occur during a staged ramp window:
  * Critical-failure rate increases >5% absolute over baseline on any severity-1 group.
  * Latency P95 increases >15% vs baseline for API endpoints used by the workflow.
  * Any single high-severity (S1) prompt returns a safety-flagged response (auto-fail).

Access notes for PHI: all eval artifacts will be written only to ClearGuide's secured S3 prefixed with /qmon/evals/clearguide/ and retention default set to 7 days unless otherwise requested. We'll include an appendix for longer retention if needed.

Attachments: canary-matrix.csv (example), qmon-runbook-draft.md (PHI appendix).

Next steps:
- Camila: confirm Friday kickoff time (Olivia already confirmed 10–11am PT).
- Dylan: can you have the Docker harness example ready to demo during the kickoff? If not, a checklist + PR template works as a fallback.
- Olivia/Rahul: please upload prompt seeds to the shared Drive folder or provide S3 access before Friday.

I'll be on the call for the technical handoff and will own the canary/runbook follow-through.

— Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: canary-matrix.csv, qmon-runbook-draft.md
